name: work package
wording: the smallest part of a cut's work given to one builder: a set of outputs, the files it writes, that no other builder changes, its commit history included, with the examples of every concept those outputs serve, so no two builders can collide; it is a vertical slice where it can be, satisfying whole examples on its own, and an output two slices both need becomes its own work package that both depend on.
